paragraphs.text: translated by
1. SEND unto us a good and happy mind.
2. I worship Agni, Youthfullest of Gods, resistless, Friend of laws;
paragraphs.original: अग्निमीळे भुजां यविष्ठं शासा मित्रं दुर्धरीतुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: agnimīḷe bhujāṃ yaviṣṭhaṃ śāsā mitraṃ durdharītum |

paragraphs.text: Under whose guard and heavenly light the Spotted seek the Mother's breast:
3. Whom with their mouth they magnify, bannered with flame and homed in light.
He glitters with his row of teeth.
4. Kind, Furtherer of men, he comes, when he hath reached the ends of heaven,
paragraphs.original: अर्यो विशां गातुरेति प्र यदानड्दिवो अन्तान् ।
paragraphs.translit: aryo viśāṃ gātureti pra yadānaḍdivo antān |

paragraphs.text: Sage, giving splendour to the clouds.
5. To taste man's offerings, he, the Strong, hath risen erect at sacrifice:
Fixing his dwelling he proceeds.
6. Here are oblation, worship, rest: rapidly comes his furtherance.
paragraphs.original: स हि क्षेमो हविर्यज्ञः श्रुष्टीदस्य गातुरेति ।
paragraphs.translit: sa hi kṣemo haviryajñaḥ śruṣṭīdasya gātureti |

paragraphs.text: To sword-armed Agni come the Gods.
7. With service for chief bliss I seek the Lord of Sacrifice, Agni, whom
They call the Living, Son of Cloud.
8. Blest evermore be all the men who come from us, who magnify
paragraphs.original: नरो ये के चास्मदा विश्वेत्ते वाम आ स्युः ।
paragraphs.translit: naro ye ke cāsmadā viśvette vāma ā syuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Agni with sacrificial gifts.
9. The path he treads is black and white and red, and striped, and brown, crimson, and glorious.
paragraphs.original: कृष्णः श्वेतोऽरुषो यामो अस्य ब्रध्न ऋज्र उत शोणो यशस्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: kṛṣṇaḥ śveto'ruṣo yāmo asya bradhna ṛjra uta śoṇo yaśasvān |

paragraphs.text: His sire begat him bright with hues of gold.
10. Thus with his thoughts, O Son of Strength, O Agni, hath Vimada, accordant with the Immortals,
paragraphs.original: एवा ते अग्ने विमदो मनीषामूर्जो नपादमृतेभिः सजोषाः ।
paragraphs.translit: evā te agne vimado manīṣāmūrjo napādamṛtebhiḥ sajoṣāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Offered thee hymns, soliciting thy favour. Thou hast brought all food, strength, a prosperous dwelling.
paragraphs.original: गिर आ वक्षत्सुमतीरियान इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं विश्वमाभाः
paragraphs.translit: gira ā vakṣatsumatīriyāna iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ
